text:
anya_pm: Quick planning thread for the tenant-safe rollout (customer asks for per-tenant opt-outs + short-lived exemptions). Need a tight, auditable flow.
frank_sre: Proposal: three-tier enforcement chain — (A) immediate hard-off kill for a tenant, (B) switch to micro/quantized variant, (C) soft-rate-limit + retry queue. Each step emits an event.
devin_prodops: For ops simplicity, expose two flags: `tenant_safety_enable` (global) and `tenant_safety_mode:<tenant>` (values: off|kill|micro|queue). The per-tenant mode should support TTL and an audit note.
rowan_devex: We should keep flag surface minimal but support bulk CSV to pre-register exemptions for pilots. API + UI for 24h TTL sounds fine. Also we need a small SDK helper to read `tenant_safety_mode` with the right precedence (tenant > region > global).
katie_sales: Customers want the ability to request a temporary exemption via chat with CS without an IR ticket. Ops team needs a one-click approve with audit. Can we gate the 24h exemptions to only a whitelist of CS reps?
frank_sre: Yes — implement RBAC on the UI for TTL exemptions. Telemetry plan: emit `safety_action{tenant, mode, reason}` as an event stream and a `safety_active{tenant}` gauge. Create alerts: global degraded >0.5% for 30m OR any tenant >4% over baseline in 5m.
anya_pm: Launch gating checklist (musts): flags + SDK, ops TTL UI with audit, SLOs & alerts, automated kill-switch, canary runs in two regions, and a short replay to estimate impact. Nice-to-have: self-serve console flow for permanent exemptions.
devin_prodops: Canary schedule suggestion: phase 1 = 3% traffic us-east-1 for 1h, phase 2 = 7% eu-central for 6h, phase 3 = 15% ap-south-1 for 24h. Also run an internal A/B where 10% of degraded traffic uses queue vs micro-model to compare latency and token-quality proxies.
rowan_devex: A/B metrics: infra (latency p50/p95, errors, retries), cost delta, and quality proxies (prompt-accuracy via eval hooks, reroll rate). Need to hook evals into canary flow.
frank_sre: Replay job: run against last 48h production logs to estimate how many tenants would trigger each tier. If replay predicts >20 tenants moving to tier B historically, we add an intermediate throttle step.
anya_pm: Ownership: product owns thresholds and runbook; SRE owns monitoring, automated thresholds, and kill automation; ProdOps owns the TTL UI and RBAC.
devin_prodops: Docs note: exemption records must include requestor, approver, reason, start_ts, expiry_ts, and correlation id. Keep TTL min=1h max=30d.
katie_sales: I'll gather top pilot tenants; requesting ability to pre-load them as `mode:micro` for the first two canaries.
rowan_devex: Flag contract draft: ```
feature: tenant_safety_v2
flags:
  - tenant_safety_enable: boolean
  - tenant_safety_mode:<tenant_id>: string (off|kill|micro|queue)  // supports TTL and audit
precedence: tenant > region > global
```
frank_sre: Alerts to implement: `safety_global_degraded_high` (global_degraded_pct > 0.5% for 30m), `safety_tenant_spike` (tenant_degraded_pct > 4% over baseline in 5m), `safety_replay_warn` (replay_estimate > 20 tenants). Auto-kill rules: on `safety_global_degraded_high` flip `tenant_safety_enable=false` global and notify oncall.
anya_pm: Runbook sketch: step 1 validate canary metrics (fail rate, latency, quality proxy), step 2 if infra issue -> auto-kill; if quality regression -> rollback micro-model for that tenant; step 3 escalate to PM + legal for contract exemptions.
devin_prodops: ETA: TTL UI prototype Wed EOD. Row an: SDK+flag reader PR by Fri. Frank: replay job + alerts by Thu. Anya: finalize thresholds & runbook Thu EOD. Katie: pilot tenant list by Tue EOD.
canary-bot: canary started us-east-1 at 2024-07-02T09:03:00Z (3% traffic) :rocket:
katie_sales: Added pilot tenants: orbit-inc, muse-ai, greenlabs.
frank_sre: Reminder: include tokenized-cost delta per micro-model in canary telemetry so finance can estimate impact.
rowan_devex: Noted. We'll emit `cost_estimate_delta` in canary logs.
anya_pm: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after phase 1 and the replay results. If replay shows many impacted tenants we'll insert a 1% intermediate throttle and re-evaluate.
